entries.5abf0cadb06a1ca8: This is the Group's largest business, operating and managing parking lots in Japan. Time-based parking lots "Times Parking" and monthly parking lots are provided in three forms: sublease contracts, under which parking attached to idle land or facilities is leased, management entrustment contracts, under which management is entrusted by owners, and self-owned. The company also operates reservation-based parking and manages facilities attached to parking lots. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥193,635 million.

entries.62003898481d12ac: In the fiscal year ended October 2025, revenue from external customers was ¥193,635 million for the domestic parking business, which accounted for nearly half of consolidated revenue of ¥406,168 million; ¥128,158 million for the mobility business; and ¥84,373 million for the overseas parking business. Domestic parking operations are the core of earnings, and the mobility business is the second pillar.
entries.663f05b0deca4500: Times Car (Car Sharing and Car Rental)
entries.66f794472c6a494b: This business provides the mobility service "Times Car," which allows users to rent cars for only the time or period they need. It combines car sharing and car rental, and can be used at staffed stores and unstaffed stations nationwide. The company also provides road service to respond to car accidents and breakdowns. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥128,158 million.

entries.78619bf32a8656c0: This business operates and manages parking lots in the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia and Taiwan. It provides pay-by-time and monthly parking lots through sublease contracts and management entrustment contracts. Based on the domestic strategy of "small, distributed and dominant" presence, it is developing low-investment parking lots (country-specific versions of Times Parking) tailored to local demand through short-term contracts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥84,373 million.

entries.b77cf5546b54ab58: In the domestic parking business, the company adopts a strategy of 'small, dispersed and dominant' formats, expanding its network while maintaining profitability by leveraging its know-how in selective development. The company is also advancing the installation of its in-house developed 'Times Tower' payment machines and the expansion of parking using vehicle-number recognition cameras, aiming for next-generation parking services that make entry, exit and payment easier.

entries.ead20c944be72e6b: In December 2024, the company announced its 'Medium-Term Management Plan for the Fiscal Year Ending October 2027' and has been advancing a three-year plan running from the fiscal year ended October 2025. In addition, under the group philosophy 'Realizing comfort that responds to the times and anticipates them', the company has set a 2035 medium- to long-term vision of 'Evolution into a mobility service platformer', and states that it is promoting the 'expansion, evolution and integration of four networks': people (members), cars (mobility), towns (destinations) and parking. The basic policies of the medium-term management plan are 'network expansion and service evolution' and 'building a foundation for sustainable growth'.
